title: Crossing Picks
heading: Curious Derek, the new promise, more angles
intro: From your timeline notes: pick the voices and the stills. I'll also hold the hands 1.5 s longer before white, and cut the music to nothing on Derek's new line; those need no picks. Earlier rounds are folded below.

sections.lede: Voices to hear and stills to pick. Pick one per row; a row's 'none' means leave it out. No video is made until you pick.

groups.title: Derek: "Hundred. ... What will it feel like?" (your note at 26 s: sounds depressed; curious Derek)
groups.line: Re-voiced curious and half impressed, the question asked with interest.

groups.title: Maddie: "I understand. ... We don't need to do this unless you're all sure." (your note at 51 s)
groups.line: Your words, said clearly and simply, with a pause after 'I understand'. Takes differ mainly in the length of that pause.

groups.title: Derek to Sandra: "It's all right, love. I'll be there with you." (your notes at 51 s and 59 s)
groups.line: New line after the promise, warm and tender. The room music fades to nothing on 'I'll be there with you', then the crossing music comes in.

groups.title: A second angle of the empty room (your note at 22 s: we hang on the overhead too long, and its lights go out)
groups.line: Eye level down an aisle, chairs bare, lights steady, clean Maddie by the hub. The overhead would play only its first 2.5 s (before its lights drop), then cut here.

groups.title: A third angle: one empty chair close
groups.line: One bare recliner, its cable and its steady glow, the room and Maddie soft behind. Lands on 'It's a bit like dying'.

opts.label: b: the room's own recliners (my pick)
c: closer, lower
opts.warn: the chair is a different, armchair style

sections.h: Round 19: clean Maddie in the clean room
sections.lede: Stills only, nothing spent yet. Pick one per row and I animate them.

groups.title: The overhead (your note at 20 s: the chair lights flicker, and Maddie is still dirty with bunting)
groups.line: Same layout from above. Maddie swapped for clean, gleaming Maddie, no bunting; every chair's light pool made one steady, even glow. The animation will hold the lights still (no breathing) and sink the camera as before.

opts.label: a: same layout
opts.warn: Maddie still looks grimy up close

groups.title: The lady's hands (your note at 39 s: Maddie needs to be clean here too)
groups.line: Her hands on the patchwork, unchanged; the robot beside her made clean, gleaming Maddie with her amber lamp.

opts.label: b: closest to the old framing (my pick)
c: Maddie further back, more of her in view

sections.lede: One pick. Everything else in round 17 stays as it is.

groups.title: The old lady: "And afterwards?" (your note: the lip sync is off)
groups.line: Her close-up re-shot twice, the prompt timing her two words, the same way Sandra was fixed. Our voice is a new quicker take (1.15 s instead of 1.4 s), laid 0.03-0.05 s after her mouth opens. "omni" is the clip with the video model's own voice.

opts.label: a-b: shot a, our voice (my pick)
a-omni: shot a, its own voice
b-omni: shot b, its own voice

sections.lede: Two choices before I cut round 17. Pick one per row (a note on a row is welcome).

groups.title: Maddie's promise: which feeling? (your note: too timid, and "sure" was cut off)
groups.line: "I won't switch it on unless you want it. All of you. And only if you're sure." Seven whole takes in four moods, pauses held to 1.2 s. Every one ends on a full "sure". Under it, the room music now fades to silence and the crossing music fades in after.

groups.title: Sandra: "I don't like the idea of… it feels like dying." (your note: the lip sync is awful)
groups.line: Re-shot twice; the prompt said when each phrase lands. Our voice is a new quicker, nervous read, laid phrase by phrase 0.07 s after her mouth opens (c and d are two takes of it). "omni" is the clip with the video model's own voice.

a-c: shot a, our voice c

b-c: shot b, our voice c

groups.line: Clean, small Maddie; no suit or gloves on the floor; blankets, mugs and empty suits left on the chairs.
